title: Firefly Choir
subtitle: A night garden of little clocks learning to glow together.
description: Tend a silent, fern-framed gathering of bioluminescent lights. Explore illustrative local phase coupling, gentle flocking, and a guiding torch, with real phase-coherence feedback and accessible playback controls.
medium: Particle study · local rhythms in a moonlit garden
instruction: Watch nearby lights find a shared rhythm. Adjust neighbor coupling, scatter their phases, or touch the clearing to lend them a torch.
